text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) study focused on environmental impacts of converting maize silage-based to grass-based dairy systems in France. While it accounts for land use change (LUC) impacts via global economic models (GTAP and LEITAP), it does not perform explicit national-scale spatially-explicit LULC predictions or simulations. The LUC analysis is based on economic model outputs without spatially explicit maps or quantitative spatial accuracy metrics. The primary focus is on environmental impact assessment (climate change, land occupation) rather than LULC prediction per se. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria related to spatial modeling with mapped LULC projections and national-scale explicit spatial implementation. It is also not a review article. Therefore, it is excluded.
